revisions.reason: Review 20261127 waveOut paused context resume: skip the existing context-resync discard for explicitly paused stream voices. Pause already captures the cursor and stops sources; Restart schedules the retained partial tail and queued headers, while Reset and Close still release them. Running unpaused stream backlog discard, callback registration/submission identity, owner retirement, completion delivery, timers, and guest memory access remain unchanged. Public WinMM x86 calls plus registered gesture unlock and an independent scheduled-PCM consumer reproduce lost samples on committed main; retained-tail, queued-before-consumption, cursor, FIFO reset, reuse, late source/timer and close checks pass after repair. Existing ownership remains pending; no hardware or Windows-reference claim. Run 20261127-waveout-pause-backlog-current-root.
